description: Symbolism and iconography asset register — modeled on the Arkane/Dishonored 9-category framework. Iteratively updated across sessions.

principles.naming: Orange Concession is inspired by old Shanghai concession zones and A Clockwork Orange. 'Orange' is a colloquial term arising from the district's visual/institutional symbolism, not a literal Chinese translation.
principles.formal_name: New Miri United Concession — 新米里联合租界
principles.design_philosophy: Systematize into families, not one-offs. Every faction and institution needs a consistent visual identity that works at multiple scales (crest, badge, banner, stamp, signage).

1_central_occult_glyph.description: The story's single load-bearing supernatural mark — analogous to Dishonored's Outsider's Mark.

assets.name: God's Blood Residue Mark / Aria's Tattoo
assets.description: Surfacing of residue from God's Blood serum (The Veiled cult, rift-derived). Permanent. Appears on Aria. Danger is bureaucratic exposure, not supernatural.
design_questions: Does the mark have a visual form (glyph, brand, pattern, organic growth)?
Is it identical on every carrier or unique per individual?
Does The Veiled cult have a corresponding carved/written version?

assets.name: Phosphor Vine Mark
assets.description: Black vine with cyan-glowing leaf veins at night. Natural warning sign of dream anomalies. NOT neon — extremely subtle.
design_questions: Does the vine carry carved glyphs or is it purely organic?
Is there a schematic/diagrammatic version used in Dreamcatcher field manuals?

2_faction_institutional_heraldry.description: Crests, sigils, badges, banners that work at many scales — embossed, embroidered, stamped, carved.

assets.name: Orange / Boulevard Authority (橙廷 Chéngtíng)
assets.description: Old money, gas lamps, opera house, stamps/passports. Mannered and quietly terrified of the ungovernable. Orange ink on cadastral map.
design_questions: What is the Boulevard Authority's crest/sigil?
How does it appear on stamps, passports, bank notes, building facades?
Typography and material language (gilt, wax, embossed paper)?

assets.name: Cobalt / Compact Maritime Concession (青海盟 Qīnghǎi Méng)
assets.description: Shipping & insurance consortium, deep-blue house flags over piers, customs houses, cargo manifests that 'never quite add up'. Cobalt never wanted a boulevard — it wanted a harbor.
design_questions: House flag design(s)?
Customs stamp and manifest markings?
How does Cobalt branding differ from Orange visually — material, weight, color register?

assets.name: The Aequorian Order (澂教)
assets.description: Secular tide-veneration faith. Symbol: abstract geometric tide-mark — horizontal line + calm arc above + rhythmic tick marks (like a tide table). Gilt on white walls. NO real-world religious symbols.
design_questions: Full symbol specification (proportions, stroke weight, arc radius)?
Variations for building façade, document seal, pendant, banner?
Hidden irony: faith venerates 'reliable return' but can't recognize Arthur Crowe's literal returns

assets.name: The Veiled (cult)
assets.description: Cult behind God's Blood serum, rift-derived experiments. Origin of Aria's tattoo.
design_questions: Cult sigil or brand?
Ritual markings and shrine iconography?
Relationship between their visual language and the God's Blood residue mark?

assets.name: NMPD / Waterfront Police Precinct
assets.description: Split building — civilian left wing under one jurisdiction, market-stall right wing under another. Same roof, two colors of law.
design_questions: Badge/insignia design?
Does the split jurisdiction show in the badge (two halves, two colors)?
Rank insignia system?

assets.name: Dreamcatchers (crew)
assets.description: The 4-player co-op paranormal investigation crew.
design_questions: Crew insignia or patch?
Equipment branding (cameras, talismans, field manuals)?
Relationship to Arthur Crowe's cinnabar seal work?

assets.name: Arthur Crowe's Network
assets.description: Benevolent protector of supernatural secrets. Cinnabar red seal work / talisman ink. Vanishes and returns across generations.
design_questions: Full glyph/sigil system for seal work?
Talisman designs and their carved markings?
How does his visual language contrast with The Veiled's?

3_occult_ritual_iconography.description: Shrines, runes, carved charms, witch marks, ritual symbols.

assets.name: Five Fundamental Orders of Mechanized Rune Magic
assets.description: Taught at the Miroir Institute. Five orders: Copper/Resonance, Iron-magnetic/Binding, Salt/Disruption, Glass/Revelation, Mirror/Reflection.
design_questions: Does each order have a distinct rune family or a single base glyph with variations?
What is the relationship between mechanized runes and The Veiled's cult iconography?
Are runes carved, etched, printed, or inscribed mechanically?

assets.name: Outsider Shrine Equivalents
assets.description: Dreamcatchers has shrine-like spaces (Tajanda Manor, etc.) but no defined shrine iconography system.
design_questions: Are there dedicated shrine spaces in the world?
What offerings/markings define a shrine vs. a random anomaly site?
Connection to the Aequorian Order's tide-mark vs. cult iconography?

assets.name: Talisman / Charm Iconography
assets.description: Arthur Crowe's talisman ink is cinnabar red. Bone charm equivalents not yet defined.
design_questions: Are there carved charm objects (bone, wood, metal)?
What markings do they carry?
How do they relate to the Five Orders runes?

4_ability_ui_glyphs.description: Power/ability icons, HUD iconography, chaos-system indicators (if applicable).

assets.name: Supernatural Ability Icons
assets.description: If the game has supernatural abilities, each needs a clean readable UI glyph in one consistent icon family.
design_questions: What abilities exist in the game design?
Is there a chaos/morality indicator system?
HUD equipment iconography style?

5_civic_signage_propaganda.description: Posters, warnings, official notices, street/shop signs, quarantine signage — period-consistent typographic style.

assets.name: The Color-Coded Cadastral Survey Map
assets.description: The founding symbolic artifact. Surveyors inked concessions in colors: orange, cobalt, uncolored fringe. The 'paint on the map' is the load-bearing chromatic logic.
design_questions: What does the actual survey map look like?
Is it displayed in government buildings, schools, museums?
Are there reproductions, or only the original?

assets.name: Jurisdiction Boundary Signage
assets.description: Authority can run out mid-crosswalk. Floor tile color indicates jurisdiction. Streetlamps, gutters, services all recolor block to block.
design_questions: Are there physical boundary markers (signs, painted lines, embedded plates)?
How do residents and police read jurisdiction at street level?
What does a checkpoint look like?

assets.name: OrangeVibe / StreamVibe
assets.description: OrangeVibe is the Boulevard's own flavor of StreamVibe — gas-lit and self-important media platform covering scandals, sales, psychic hotline ads.
design_questions: Masthead/logo design?
How does OrangeVibe's visual identity differ from base StreamVibe?
Poster, screen, and print formats?

assets.name: Wanted / Official Notice Posters
assets.description: No wanted posters or official notices designed yet, but the world calls for them (Adrian's case, Aria's anomaly flag, etc.).
design_questions: What does an NMPD wanted poster look like?
What does an Aequorium mandatory-reporting notice look like?
Are notices color-coded by jurisdiction?

6_commercial_branding.description: Product labels, business logos, commercial marks — the industrial-economy feel.

assets.name: Orange Currency / Bank Stamps
assets.description: Orange money clears faster than any other currency at a Boulevard bank window. Orange papers get you further at checkpoints.
design_questions: Coin design, paper currency design?
Bank stamp and seal designs?
How does Cobalt currency differ visually?

assets.name: Product Labels & Commercial Marks
assets.description: No commercial products branded yet. The world's economy (harbor trade, gas-lit boulevard commerce, Outskirts gray market) calls for product labels, shop signs, business logos.
design_questions: What are the key commercial products in New Miri?
How do Orange vs. Cobalt vs. Outskirts commercial branding differ?
Are there branded goods that cross jurisdictional lines?

7_print_media_paperwork.description: Mastheads, book/pamphlet covers, letterheads, wax seals, official forms.

assets.name: Official Forms & Paperwork
assets.description: The world runs on paperwork — mandatory-reporting statutes, custody releases, discharge papers, cargo manifests, customs forms. Adrian's career ended over a buried report.
design_questions: What does an Aequorium anomaly-report form look like?
NMPD discharge papers, custody transfer documents?
Cobalt customs manifests vs. Orange bank paperwork — visual differences?

assets.name: Books & Pamphlets
assets.description: No in-world books or pamphlets designed yet. The Miroir Institute, Aequorian Order, and The Veiled all imply printed materials.
design_questions: Miroir Institute textbooks on the Five Orders?
Aequorian Order devotional pamphlets?
The Veiled cult texts or codices?

assets.name: Wax Seals & Official Stamps
assets.description: Orange stamps on passports, Cobalt customs stamps, Aequorium registry seals. Arthur Crowe's cinnabar seal work.
design_questions: Design system for official seals across all three jurisdictions?
Arthur Crowe's personal seal vs. institutional seals?
How do forgeries and counterfeits look different?

8_currency_cartography_economy.description: Coin design, city maps, trade markers, the economic backbone.

assets.name: City Maps & Cartographic Conventions
assets.description: The harbor survey map is the founding document. City maps with their own iconographic conventions are needed.
design_questions: What cartographic symbols are used for jurisdictions, anomalies, precincts?
Are there different map styles for official vs. street-level use?
How are dream-anomaly sites marked on maps?

assets.name: Harbor & Trade Economy Markers
assets.description: Cobalt's shipping economy — cargo manifests, crane marks, warehouse brands, refinery marks. The whale-oil equivalent.
design_questions: What is New Miri's primary trade commodity (the whale-oil equivalent)?
Harbor infrastructure branding?
How does trade goods branding cross jurisdictional lines?

9_menu_framing_symbolism.description: Chapter cards, loading-screen imagery, narrative framing symbols.

assets.name: Chapter / Mission Cards
assets.description: Story chapters: An Orange Problem, The Child Prodigy, The Porch Light, Money Is In The Dream, The Crew Assembles. No chapter card designs yet.
design_questions: Tarot-like card system (Dishonored) or different framing?
What visual motif ties the chapter cards together?
How do chapter cards reflect the concession color system?

assets.name: 'An Orange Problem' — Narrative-Symbolic Motif
assets.description: The local idiom for trouble in jurisdictional gaps where the Dream Layer leaks. A narrative-symbolic concept that could become a visual motif.
design_questions: Is there a visual shorthand for 'Orange Problem' (a stamp, a mark, a color gradient)?
Could this be the framing device for mission/chapter cards?

color_palette.description: Established cross-location color signatures from the world's design system.

colors.name: Orange (concession)
colors.usage: Boulevard Authority ink, stamps, cadastral map — exact shade not yet pinned

colors.name: Cobalt (concession)
colors.usage: Compact Maritime house flags, customs ink — exact shade not yet pinned

changes: Created asset register with 9-category Arkane framework
Established formal name: New Miri United Concession — 新米里联合租界
Orange remains colloquial term from visual/institutional symbolism, not literal translation
Inventoried all narrative-defined assets from existing canon (content.json, world-builder memory)
Identified design gaps across all 9 categories
